hypotheses.justification: The statement does not need this instance to elaborate. `finrank K V` is defined for any module, and `elementaryGroup Q` is `Subgroup.closure` of a set of Eichler transformations in `V ≃ₗ[K] V` (Eichler.lean), with no finiteness assumption. `polarBilin Q` and `IsSimpleGroup` are also independent of it. The hypothesis `hd : 6 ≤ finrank K V` already implies it: `Module.finite_of_finrank_pos` (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Dimension/Free.lean) turns `0 < finrank K V` into `Module.Finite K V`. Over a field, `Module.Free` is available as an instance. So the theorem stays true with the instance omitted (`omit [FiniteDimensional K V] in`). The proof needs one extra line before the existing term: `haveI : FiniteDimensional K V := Module.finite_of_finrank_pos (by omega)`. The downstream lemmas `isSimpleGroup_elementaryGroup_of_perfect` and `commutator_elementaryGroup_eq_top_f2` then get their instance from that local `have`.
